read.thesis: Siemens Q3 orders hit a record €27.9bn (+14% comparable) with Industrial margin at 17.3% and EPS pre-PPA guidance raised to €11.20–11.50, though no capacity or capex signals were disclosed.

utilisation.quote: improved capacity utilization and ongoing productivity measures

triggers.label: EPS pre-PPA guide raised
triggers.quote: Outlook raised: Basic earnings per share (for net income) before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) raised to a range of between €11.20 and €11.50 (previously: €10.70 and €11.10)

triggers.label: Orders +14% to record €27.9bn
triggers.quote: Orders in Q3 2026 climbed 14 percent on a comparable basis, reaching a record high of €27.9 billion

triggers.label: Smart Infra profitability 20.0%
triggers.quote: Smart Infrastructure increased profit to €1.3 billion and profitability to 20.0 percent

guidance.quote: raised to a range of between €11.20 and €11.50 (previously: €10.70 and €11.10)
we once again aim to achieve a double-digit free-cash-flow return on revenue
